data.one_liner: A null-safe image carousel widget with customizable indicators and overlays.
data.what_it_does: Provides a carousel widget capable of cycling through a list of images (network or assets) with autoplay capabilities, customizable dot indicators, animation curves, border radii, and overlay shadows.
use_when: You need a simple image slider or banner carousel in your Flutter application.
You want built-in dot indicators and autoplay features out of the box.
avoid_when: You need complex page view layouts that go beyond simple image sequences.
You require highly customized custom child widgets inside the carousel instead of standard images.
strengths: Easy to set up and use with a wide range of customization options (dots, radius, autoplay, shadows).
Null-safe implementation of the classic Carousel Pro package.
weaknesses: Limited primarily to image lists rather than arbitrary widget builders.
Lacks advanced modern carousel features found in newer packages.
